stem:
Zubin studies classroom lockers numbered $1$ to $20$. A locker is touched exactly twice when its number has exactly two factors, $1$ and itself.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.text: Lockers $1$, $2$, $3$, $5$ and $7$ are all touched exactly twice.
Lockers $2$, $3$, $5$, $7$, $11$, $13$, $17$ and $19$ are touched exactly twice.
Locker $1$ is not touched exactly twice.
Locker $20$ is touched exactly twice because $20$ is the last locker number.

teacher.key_rationale: Touched exactly twice means prime: 2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19 within 1..20. Locker 1 has only one factor, so it is excluded. Listing 1 with primes, or choosing 20 for being last, miss that test.
